rationale: Centered additive metabolic-risk circuit. Support mean is the baseline. Within strata of the other major risk factors, upper-minus-lower half mean contrasts give target-unit slopes per input SD of BMI 32.4, log-triglycerides 35.1, BP 13.9, and HDL -13.0. BMI and log-TG contrast groups still differ in HDL and other risk markers, so shared evidence is discounted to 28 and 30; BP is rounded to 14. HDL is adjusted to -15 because the high-HDL group is enriched for sex 1. The stratified sex-2-minus-sex-1 target contrast -8.4 still contains higher BMI, BP and lower HDL risk, motivating -26 after subtracting those positive risks. Sex is centered at its support frequency; numeric inputs are already centered. Age, glucose, and redundant cholesterol measures are omitted to avoid noisy duplicate evidence. Weights are rounded from descriptive contrasts and nuisance imbalances, not optimized.
